name: hp3000-hacker-replicant
description: AI tutor/copilot chat panel for a Raspberry Pi-hosted HP3000 Series II/MPE replica -- knows MPE (Multi-Programming Executive), the HP3000's stack-machine architecture, and its business-computing history, and can optionally operate the machine's console. LLM-agnostic: works with any OpenAI-compatible backend (Ollama locally by default, or any hosted provider).
